MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 30

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 15
   D. 7

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 34
   D. 22

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

10. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

14. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

21. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 25

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

24. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
